description: Charter flight destinations sold by Rainbow Tours (biletyczarterowe.r.pl) matching optional destination/origin/date filters: per destination you get the country, region, nearest departure date, baggage allowance and the lowest per-person price. Prices are charter seat prices in PLN. Use rainbow_search_outbound for day-by-day flights to one destination. Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, search_url, count, flights: [...], price_range: { min, max } } — the list key is `flights`, but each entry is a DESTINATION, not a single flight: { destination, destination_iata, country, region, departure_date, price_per_person, currency, baggage_kg }.

destinations.description: Destination IATA codes to filter by, e.g. ['AYT','HRG']. Omit for all.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

one_way.description: Search one-way charters instead of returns. Default false.

origins.description: Polish origin IATA codes to filter by, e.g. ['WAW','KTW']. Omit for all.

name: rainbow_search_charters
title: Rainbow charter destinations
